newsitem.title: COLOMBIA: Colombian stocks close stable after bullish week.
newsitem.headline: Colombian stocks close stable after bullish week.

text.p: Colombian stocks ended mostly unchanged in trading dominated by prime blue chips, dealers said.
Bogota's IBB price index ended unchanged at 1,329.44 on volume of 4.9 billion pesos. Medellin's IBOMED general price index closed up 0.75 percent at 19,847.54 on volume of 5.6 billion pesos.
Dealers said the markets were recovering from the healthy gains earlier this week and only a few stocks registered significant movement.
Brewing giant Bavaria was one of the day's gainers, closing up 1.47 percent in Bogota at 10,350 pesos and up 2.06 percent at 10,400 in Medellin
Banco Ganadero, the nations largest bank in terms of assets, however, finished the day down 2.82 percent in Bogota to 447 pesos.
Cement maker Cementos Paz del Rio closed up 0.82 percent to 1,230 in Medellin.
